settings.name: MMLU
settings.description: 2000 fixed-seed questions across 57 subjects, 5-shot, A–D single-token logits, paired McNemar test.

settings.name: GSM8K
settings.description: 500 questions, 0-shot, greedy up to 512 tokens, reasoning disabled, exact final-number match.

settings.name: perplexity
settings.description: 100K-token WikiText-103 and CodeParrot samples, context 2048, byte-identical chunks; held-out WikiText checks k2 selection.

settings.name: routing analysis
settings.description: 500K tokens/domain with forward hooks over all gates.

data.correctness: Lossy compute reduction; statistically non-significant downstream difference is not proof of exact equivalence.
data.methodology: Scan k2 while holding k1 fixed to separate expert capacity loss from gain miscalibration; paired tests are used because effects are sub-percent to few-percent.
data.scope: Main matched k1/k2 evidence is two Qwen fine-grained MoEs from same series; third-architecture Gemma uses earlier scalar-gain formulation and is directional only.
